messages.subject: Non-integer response
parts:
I have trap arrays placed across my study area, with 6 traps per array.  I am trapping invertebrates so there exists lethal removal per each trap.  Given that some traps get knocked over, etc, there are NA's spread throughout.  I had hoped to use gmultmix() to model the multinomial response of the taxa to my environmental covariates.  I am wondering if I can use a mean value of individuals captured per trap array per time period (non-integers) as opposed to an integer response value (0,1,2,3,4....).  I understand that logistically it is impossible to trap 1.7 individuals, but is it feasible to use such a non-integer value, derived from an average, within the gmultmix model?

Thanks!
Andrew
